steps.content: You rest in the cellar for a long time, until the barest shred of strength returns.
Hilda's left shoulder is ruined, and your own hands aren't much better.
The only thing that matters—the only victory—is that you're both still alive.

At some point, Hilda drags her injured body back toward the explosion site. She returns clutching a communication module salvaged from the Monolith remains. With some repairs, it could work as a radio.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm sorry, my fingers can't handle such delicate work anymore.
You watch Hilda busily working and can only spread your hands in resignation, forced to remain a helpless spectator.

She is truly impressive in this department. With just one good arm, she not only bandages your hands with practiced ease but also performs the most intricate repair work. She mentions, offhandedly, that her spy training included assembling radios blindfolded—and that she received top marks.
Hilda lets out a short laugh, her hands never pausing in their methodical dance.
Slowly, a makeshift communication radio begins to take shape. It's only then that she finally breaks the silence.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, didn't you say before... you wanted to know how I transformed, and what abilities I gained?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I think... if I don't tell you now, I might never get another chance...

Three Months Ago
DisCity Port

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: Help! Somebody, help! There's been a gas explosion! The whole area's gone! There could be dozens of people trapped in there!

steps.speaker: Crowd B
steps.content: Is it over?! Don't go in until it's over! We can't have more people dying!

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Wha... what's going on...?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Was that... an attack?

She still remembers what happened minutes ago. She and her colleagues had intercepted intelligence about special military equipment being smuggled between the farlands and DisCity. Acting immediately, they had headed to the port to seize the contraband.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: My head... hurts...
Everything around her was in ruins. The explosion had collapsed the ground, sending her tumbling into a mining tunnel below.
Two crates of military equipment had shattered open, their contents strewn across the ground and littered over her body.

They seemed like crystals, transparent with a pink tint, as if they had been distilled from wind and sand. Tiny particles of energy orbited their cores. Freed from their sealed containers, the latent power within them began to awaken.

Shards had driven deep into her flesh during the blast. Like living organisms, they drank her blood, gradually turning bright red and growing scorching hot. A searing pain gripped her entire body as every vein convulsed and churned.
Before her reeling mind could make sense of it, an enemy lunged from the shadows, slashing a jagged blade toward her hand.
Hilda instinctively raised her arm to block. A metallic clang echoed in the tunnel, and she saw her attacker clearly—a figure wielding an eerie weapon, utterly devoid of any living presence.

In its grasp was a broken, grotesque thing, pieced together like shards of metal forged from countless battlefield souls. When it swung, the very air seemed to thin, sucking the breath from Hilda's lungs.
—It was DisCity's Reaper. Only moments before, it had been her colleague. Now, it was a horrifying soldier-like monster.
So this was DisCity's combat weapon?
It could transform a person into a monster in seconds?!
The enemy gave her no time to think, its assault relentless.

The Reaper's blade sliced her skin, and an icy chill flooded her flesh faster than the pain could register. This new cold warred against the burning heat inside her, two violent forces battling for control of her body.

steps.speaker: Sinister Whispers
steps.content: Give me... surrender yourself to me... she is mine... mine...

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Cough... What is... this...? Ugh! ...This is bad!
The chilling whispers spread through her bloodstream, making her very bone marrow tremble.
Gritting her teeth, she shook off her pursuer and stumbled away from the port, fleeing for her life.
Just as her consciousness began to shatter, a strip of telegraph paper seemed to materialize before her eyes.
Left, forward, don't stop.
Guided by those cryptic words, she finally escaped.
[End of Flashback]

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Just a tiny scratch is enough to plant this curse... If mastered on a large scale, this weapon would be more terrifying than Corruptors, capable of becoming a devastating threat. We must remain vigilant against DisCity at all times and establish proper defenses.

She later returned to the site, searching for her colleague who had succumbed to the Reaper's corruption. There, deep within the earth, she found only his exhausted corpse. Using her power, she drew forth his final, fading memories.
That harrowing experience forever colored her view of DisCity as a place of existential threat. It also explains her profound shock upon discovering the smuggling list within Manphist's memories.

Now, you finally learn the whole story of her awakening. In the era of the metropoles, Ash Crystals did create Sinners, but not through deliberate cultivation. Her transformation was a tragic accident, a fate she never chose.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: That code strip, appearing whenever I needed it, became my compass, helping me evade pursuit and guiding me all the way back to the safe house.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: For a long time afterward, I practiced using this power while learning to endure the backlash it caused.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: It constantly gnaws at my nerves and willpower. If I stop fighting it, I'll eventually be completely consumed by this power.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: But I also know this is a gift bestowed upon me. This ability is the ultimate trump card for an intelligence agent, and I will tame it and wield it.
Hilda raises a finger, commanding your attention. From the fading glow of the Monolith's remains, she draws forth a single, shimmering thread of new intelligence code.
After these long days, the arcane patterns of the telegraph codes have become strangely familiar. You lean in, your eyes narrowing to decipher the text materializing at her fingertips:

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Material components: zinc, iron, tin, cotton... Doesn't seem like information worth concealing.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: The quantity and depth of intelligence I gather depend on how long I use my power.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: And not everyone's mind is easily readable. Those with special training can conceal their consciousness in deeper layers, requiring more time from me to uncover.
So this was her plan all along: this gathering, this manor—all a carefully staged scenario to buy herself enough time in close contact to interrogate every suspect.

With no one to guide her, she was forced to forge her own path. She endured the searing pain and dangerous backlash, time and again, pushing herself to master a power that constantly threatened to consume her.
Her progress came at a terrible cost. Though she achieved remarkable results, each success left her balancing on the razor's edge, both mentally and physically shattered.
Fortunately, she found you. In you, she found an anchor, the one thing strong enough to keep her from being torn apart by the Mania or swallowed by the encroaching madness.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, you helped me many times at the manor, even saved my life. I'll always remember this debt.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Of course, I'll also always remember how you manipulated me and took my code strip.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Only when I'm with you... do I unconsciously find confidence in the future...

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Only then do I realize I'm not fighting this battle alone.
Her words are spiraling into a dangerous place, and you can't stay silent. With your safe escape so close within reach, you refuse to let her surrender to despair.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even when I'm not by your side, you can still believe you're not fighting alone.
She offers a faint, almost imperceptible smile.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...${PlayerName}, if in the end you're the only one who makes it out alive, remember to come back for my body.

options: Don't talk like that. You're making it out alive too.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Remember, come back for my body.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Rather than fantasizing about both of us surviving, we should prepare for when things go wrong.
(Paths converge)
A knowing smile touches her lips as she taps a finger against her temple in the dim light. Catching your look of disbelief, she allows a flicker of satisfaction to show in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Because the real Monolith is right here.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I prepared two contingency plans. One is the machine you saw, large, conspicuous, almost shouting to everyone who sees it, "I am the Monolith, come destroy me." It's real, of course, but primarily serves as bait.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: The other was "preserving only the core data." Using my power, I materialized and deconstructed its core data, storing it in my mind. I believe extracting it won't be difficult for you.
Her words are soft, each one spoken like a line from a last testament.

steps.speaker: Option
options: We're definitely getting out of here.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We're not at our last resort yet, so let's not speak so lightly of life and death.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Remember, we survived an almost certainly fatal explosion, then crawled with all our might from sealed ruins. Even a real nuclear bomb would think twice before taking us on.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Our mission is to bring the truth we've uncovered here to the outside world and expose it to the public.

Though it will be several decades later than she hopes, the chance will come. As long as she's willing to "wake up," she will witness the day the truth is revealed. Then, she can at least secure her own defense and, at long last, restore her parents' honor.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What we need to do... is survive.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let me tell you a secret: that "poison pill" you found suspicious earlier was just candy I snuck in. Here, have some too. We should conserve our energy while we wait for rescue.
You retrieve the candy from your collar, only to find it has weathered the chaos into a fine powder.
Without ceremony, you tip half of the sweet dust into Hilda's mouth and pour the rest onto your own tongue.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Mmph.
Surprise flashes in her widened eyes. The sudden burst of sugar dissolves on her tongue, a vibrant, shocking spark against the gloom. The taste of being alive.
And then, slowly, surely, a smile touches her lips.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...To think I was actually fooled by such a crude piece of candy from the very beginning.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Well then... I'll hold on a little longer...
With that, she presses the transmitter's button. A small light winks on, and you can almost feel its rhythmic pulse beating skyward into the silence.
